name: Golden PM
subtitle: Projects for Golden A/S PMs
promotionalText: Projects, approvals, drawings, team and inbox — the project manager's view of the Golden A/S portal.
description:
Golden PM is the project-management application for the project managers of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S), the marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Keratsini, Greece, with branches in Italy and the Netherlands.

An account issued by Golden A/S is required. The app is a companion to the Golden A/S portal and is not intended for the general public.

With it a project manager can:
• follow every project and sub-project with progress, issues and submittals
• approve timesheets, leave requests and parts requisitions from the team
• track drawings and documents due to the yard and the classification society
• read the inbox of portal notifications and reminders
• see the team on site, their requests and who is away
• work offline and synchronise later
• In / Out: clock in and clock out with the time and the position at that moment

Sign-in with password and authenticator code, or with Face ID / Touch ID and passkeys after the first sign-in. All data stays on the Golden A/S portal; nothing is shared with third parties.
whatsNew: New: In / Out under More — clock in and clock out with the time and one position taken at that moment (no tracking in between), after accepting the notice once. Entries of the last 14 days with their status and a map link.
reviewNotes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING
Attached in the Attachment field of this App Review Information section (GoldenPM_review_recording.mp4). Recorded on a physical iPhone with the demonstration account; it shows: launch from the home screen, sign-in, Home, Team (who is away), Projects with a project and a sub-project, Approvals (drawings marked received, submittals), More, the app lock opened with Face ID, and sign-out.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Golden PM is the internal project-management app of Golden A/S (Golden Automation Systems), a marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Piraeus, Greece. It is used only by the company's own project managers. It lets them follow their projects away from the desk: progress of every project and sub-project, issues, drawings and submittals due to the shipyard and the classification society, approval of timesheets, leave requests and parts requisitions of their team, and who is on site. It works offline and synchronises later. It is not intended for the general public.

3. ACCESS
Sign in with the demo account given in the App Review Information section (project-manager role, no authenticator code needed). This account is a demonstration account: the app shows a built-in demonstration data set (invented projects, vessels and people) and no company data. Tabs: Home, Projects, Approvals, Team, More. In / Out (More › In / Out) registers the start and end of work: the notice is accepted once, then when the button is pressed the app asks for the location (When In Use), takes one position and sends it with the time to the company server; there is no background location and no tracking. With the demonstration account the entries are invented and what is registered is not kept in the company records. The link "Open in Google Maps" on an entry opens Google Maps with the stored coordinates. The app has no account registration: accounts are created by the company administrator in the company portal, so there is no in-app account creation or deletion. An employee's account is closed by the administrator when employment ends.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
The app talks only to Golden A/S's own server (https://www.goldensas.com) over HTTPS. No third-party analytics, advertising or payment service is used. Sign-in uses the company's own accounts, with optional authenticator (TOTP) and passkeys; Face ID / Touch ID is used on the device only. The app registers with Apple Push Notification service for notifications; no other notification service is used. An optional writing assistant, switched off unless the company administrator enables it for an account, sends the text of the form the user is editing through the company server to the Anthropic Claude API to propose wording; the user decides whether to use the proposal.

5. REGIONS
The app works the same in all regions. Languages: English, Greek, Italian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian.

6. REGULATED CONTENT
None. The app contains no third-party protected material, no purchases and no paid content. Project data belongs to Golden A/S and its customers and is processed under the privacy policy: https://www.goldenas.com.gr/privacy.html

USER CONTENT
Notes and comments are exchanged only between signed-in employees of the company; there is no public content.

DISTRIBUTION
The app is for the company's own staff. We will request unlisted distribution for it once approved, so that it is not discoverable on the App Store.
